entities.summary: Sabine Beate Kusterer is a German weightlifter. She competed in the women's 58 kg event at the 2016 Summer Olympics held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. She also competed in the women's 59 kg event at the 2020 Summer Olympics held in Tokyo, Japan.
